single_npc.policy: exact named NPC/map/anchor/service used for both accept and delivery;no split endpoint fields

split_npc.policy: accept only accept endpoint,deliver only delivery endpoint;all eight explicit;never use acceptance endpoint for reward;no single endpoint fields

lifecycle.qualification: alive,out of combat,idle,no challenge;minimum_level and exact current route from own quest;original current role/inventory valid;operation uses declared interaction_model endpoint within2500mm and same map;no sidequest prerequisite or public-transit bypass
lifecycle.acceptance: only not_accepted and never delivered;create unique attempt,no fee or starting grant;active/delivered accept rejects
lifecycle.readiness: derive each requirements quantity from actual own-character/quest/current-attempt carried bound items;all required quantities satisfied;no shadow progress counter or preaccept credit
lifecycle.repeat: each quest once per character across worlds;no daily/party/route reset;parameter-center route changes preserve all completion records and do not authorize old active attempt against current route
lifecycle.delivery: revalidate all eligibility/current attempt/exact delivery endpoint/inputs;build final inventory by consuming exact declared quantities then inserting exact reward.items under original definition/binding/provenance/merge/slot/weight rules;preflight currencies and XP/derived level/attribute/covered-level awards;one05/19durable transaction commits inputs/items/silver/practice/actual XP and newly covered level awards/state/completion/receipt/resource flows;character and inventory revisions each+1 once
lifecycle.silver: reward.silver explicit nonnegative integer;zero causes no money leg or money-account mutation;positive amount requires carried before+reward<=17maximum and exact authorized quest_reward income leg for reward.silver,warehouse unchanged;overflow rejects entire delivery,no clipping
lifecycle.practice: reward.practice explicit nonnegative integer;applied=min(reward.practice,maximum-current),overflow=reward.practice-applied;preview original/applied/loss and explicit confirmation if loss>0;zero causes no practice mutation;no XP conversion/extra material/refund or party redistribution
lifecycle.reward_scope: these twenty-two quests require explicit nonnegative integer reward.experience,rank_change=null,ascension_progress=0;XP follows experience rule below,rank/ascension change remains outside this owner and rejects;exact quest reward values still belong to each registered owner,no hidden grants
lifecycle.capacity_failure: any invalid original/final state,missing input,slots/weight shortage,silver overflow or stale revision rejects whole delivery,all inputs/quest attempt/rewards/RNG/revisions unchanged;no partial/ground/warehouse delivery
lifecycle.modifiers: declared quest reward values fixed;outside party pool/finisher/training/supreme multipliers
lifecycle.abandon: explicit confirmation consumes only own active-attempt declared quest tokens and clears attempt/state atomically;no refund/reward;completed cannot abandon;fresh accept allocates new attempt,old commands/death outcomes never target new attempt;other task inputs/state unaffected
lifecycle.deduplication: character/quest/final completion unique across attempts/worlds;original request same payload returns original receipt before current-state checks;altered payload same request rejects;new completion after delivered rejects;never reinstall historical receipt inventory
lifecycle.save: persist actual tokens/attempt/state/result and resource flows under05/19;uncertain persistence resolves original settlement and retries same committed save,no new credit/items or business replay
